scripts.smoke: mkdir -p reports && docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work -e BASE_URL -e API_PATH -e METHOD -e AUTH_TOKEN -e REQUEST_BODY -e EXPECTED_STATUS -e SLEEP_SECONDS -e TIMEOUT -e TEST_TYPE=smoke -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_PERIOD=1s -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=/work/reports/smoke-report.html grafana/k6:latest run --summary-export=/work/reports/smoke-summary.json /work/scripts/api-performance.js
scripts.load: mkdir -p reports && docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work -e BASE_URL -e API_PATH -e METHOD -e AUTH_TOKEN -e REQUEST_BODY -e EXPECTED_STATUS -e SLEEP_SECONDS -e TIMEOUT -e TEST_TYPE=load -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_PERIOD=1s -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=/work/reports/load-report.html grafana/k6:latest run --summary-export=/work/reports/load-summary.json /work/scripts/api-performance.js
